relationships.evidence_quote: This study demonstrates that TGF-β1 mediates EMT in bladder epithelial cells via ROCK, contributing to IC/BPS pathogenesis

relationships.subject: TGF-β1
relationships.evidence_quote: Rho-associated kinase (ROCK), a downstream effector of TGF-β1, may be involved in this process.

relationships.subject: Y-27632
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of TGF-β1 and ROCK reversed these changes, though the ROCK inhibitor did not affect TGF-β1 levels.

key_findings: In cyclophosphamide-induced IC rats, TGF-β1, ROCK and fibrosis markers were upregulated and E-cadherin reduced; TGF-β1 and ROCK inhibition reversed this.
ROCK inhibitor did not affect TGF-β1 levels, placing ROCK downstream.
